scheme_name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the Children of Parents/Guardians Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations - Goa
other_conditions: The applicant must be a student studying full‑time in Class I to X.
The applicant must be a resident of Goa.
The applicant’s parents/guardians must be engaged in an unclean or hazardous occupation (e.g., manual scavengers, tanners, waste pickers, hazardous cleaning).
The applicant must not be holding any other educational scholarship for studying in Class I to X (or must inform the awarding authority if they hold another).
A certificate from the District Social Welfare Officer or the designated authority must be submitted to verify the parents’/guardians’ occupation.
benefits_summary: Provides a consolidated academic allowance of ₹3,500 per annum for day scholars and ₹8,000 per annum for hostellers (Class III‑X), with an additional 10% allowance for disabled students.
documents_required: Certificate from District Social Welfare Officer or designated authority
